lines.en: Chika isn’t on break when I make it to the mall, so I head over to her store (Which I still can not pronounce the name of) and decide to spend the afternoon with her there.
lines.zh: 我到商场时 Chika 还不在休息，于是我直接去她店里（那店名我到现在还念不出来），决定陪她在那儿过个下午。

lines.en: It’s busy, but not so much that it takes away any of our time together as even when she’s helping customers, she still seems very focused on what I’m doing.
lines.zh: 店里挺忙的，但也没忙到占用我们相处的时间——就算她在招呼客人，她的注意力似乎还是放在我身上。

lines.en: I guess that sort of thing is to be expected given just how big a part of her life I’ve become, though.
lines.zh: 不过考虑到我已经成了她生活里多大的一部分，这也在意料之中。

lines.en: She also seems to pick on cues pretty well as every time someone sees the two of us together and attacks us with a gaze of skepticism, she starts slinging customer service dialogue at me like it's second nature.
lines.zh: 她对别人的眼色也接得挺准——每次有人看到我们俩在一起、投来怀疑的目光，她就会条件反射般地对我甩出一堆客服话术。

lines.en: And might I add that the customer service here is exceptional since the two of us wind up making out in the dressing room shortly after that.
lines.zh: 顺便一提，这儿的客户服务堪称一流，因为没过多久我们就跑到更衣室里亲热去了。

lines.en: Things don’t progress any further as Chika still seems a little hesitant about going all the way in public after our talk some time ago.
lines.zh: 事情没有进一步，因为在我们前些日子那次谈话之后，Chika 对在公共场合做到底还是有点犹豫。

lines.en: Just...not hesitant enough to hold herself back from kissing me, I guess. Which is fair.
lines.zh: 只是……还没犹豫到能忍住不亲我，我想。这也合理。

lines.en: I could talk my way out of that if someone saw the two of us.
lines.zh: 要是有人看见我们俩，我还能靠嘴皮子圆过去。

lines.en: What I don’t think I could talk my way out of is someone finding me secretly fucking a teenager while she’s on the clock.
lines.zh: 但我圆不过去的是——有人发现我在她上班的时候偷偷干一个十几岁的女孩。

lines.en: But hey, maybe if I start thinking up excuses now, I’ll be able to some day.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，也许现在开始想借口，总有一天能想出来。

lines.en: Until then...I’ll just have to keep making out with her, I guess.
lines.zh: 在那之前……我大概只能继续跟她亲热了。
Chika 的好感度提升到了 [chika_love]！
